overview: By the bench, after the wheel had gone down the yard, you wrote one sentence on the tables. An even wheel is rarer than a true one. You did not write it again at night.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the line and did not add a second one.

assets.disposition: Wrote that an even wheel is rarer than a true one
